title: Detailed magnifying glass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- handle -->
  <rect x='66' y='62' width='9' height='30' rx='4' fill='#8B5A2B' transform='rotate(-45 70 77)'/>
  <rect x='66' y='62' width='3' height='30' rx='1.5' fill='#C08552' transform='rotate(-45 70 77)'/>
  <!-- handle ferrule -->
  <rect x='60' y='58' width='12' height='8' rx='2' fill='#D9B031' transform='rotate(-45 66 62)'/>
  <rect x='60' y='58' width='5' height='8' rx='2' fill='#F2D670' transform='rotate(-45 66 62)'/>
  <!-- rim -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='30' fill='none' stroke='#C9A227' stroke-width='7'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='30' fill='none' stroke='#F2D670' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='26' fill='none' stroke='#8A6D12' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- glass -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='25' fill='#2E7BC4'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='25' fill='#5FB0E8' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- glass shine -->
  <path d='M26 30 Q32 24 42 23' fill='none' stroke='#DFF2FF' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M24 40 Q25 34 28 31' fill='none' stroke='#DFF2FF' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- little sparkle inside -->
  <circle cx='54' cy='52' r='4' fill='#BFE4FF' opacity='0.65'/>
</svg>
